thesis: Hold. Items published before the 18:00Z cutoff do not clear a sized long. New since 17:30Z: Luvu Brands (17:53Z) is an Item 2.02/9.01 with no results and no ticker in the summary; the 17:45Z Medicare Advantage note says plans will be cheaper next year and that open enrollment starts Oct. 15, but names no issuer, so the margin-versus-enrollment effect is not a trade; Fidelity Core Real Estate Fund (17:43Z) is Item 7.01 with no disclosure text; Federal Home Loan Bank of Cincinnati (17:34Z) and Des Moines (17:31Z) are Item 2.03 obligations, not equities; Stone Point Credit Corp (17:33Z) is Item 8.01/9.01 with no event described. Carryover in this pack still lacks terms: Deutsche Bank's 16:45Z Netflix note has no subscriber figure, rating, or target; Citi's 16:59Z Starship note names no US-listed ticker; Carnival's 13:16Z Item 2.02 has no figures; the 16:24Z breadth note says the S&P 500 was within 2 points of a record close while many stocks are in a bear market, but names neither the weak names nor a reason to add to or cut VTI; the 16:33Z-16:41Z United States commodity-fund 8-Ks are Item 7.01 only. Context prints (as_of 04:00-05:00Z, not this hour's tape) are VIX 16.29 (+0.22), the 10-year at 5.266%, TLT 78.05 (-0.72%), and WTI 89.81 / USO 144.48 lower, with no causal oil headline and no duration reversal, so cash stays unspent on energy and bonds. The book remains one VTI lot (0.6647 sh, about $249, ~25% of ~$999 equity) and about $750 cash.
